response.sql: WITH status_avg AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS st, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM status_avg), kept1 AS (SELECT a.st, a.avg_pulse, a.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM status_avg a CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE a.avg_pulse > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.st, k.avg_pulse, k.excess1, k.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM kept1 k CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k.avg_pulse > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_final, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM kept2
